entities.name: Agnes Elizabeth Lloyd Bennett
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Agnes Elizabeth Lloyd Bennett was an Australian New Zealand doctor, a Chief Medical Officer of a World War I medical unit for which she was awarded the Serbian Order of St Sava and later was awarded an O.B.E. for her services in improving the health of women and children.
